## Workload

Elif Sahin graded 632 sets during 450 rostered hours. This represents an average throughput of 1.4 sets per hour. The workload recorded for the review period was therefore consistent with the activity reported for the grading function. The calculation is based on the stated number of sets graded and the total rostered hours.

## Quality

A sample of 55 sets was read again as part of the quality review. Agreement was 80.0 per cent. This result provides the basis for the quality assessment recorded in this review and should be considered alongside the workload information above.

No further action is required this quarter. The review was completed by Priya Anand, who considered both the recorded workload and the findings from the repeat reading.
